xref.title: Solo Work After Rage Against the Machine (Fall 2000)
xref.body: After his departure from Rage Against the Machine in the fall of 2000, Zack de la Rocha pursued solo work, collaborating with producers like DJ Shadow and Dan The Automator, and later Trent Reznor. Despite these efforts, he struggled to complete a full album, often feeling uninspired. "When Zach De La Roca left Raging Against the Machine in the fall of 2000, it was almost a given that he would move on to some kind of solo work. He did. But then he kind of got lost. He worked with a series of DJ slash producers like DJ Shadow and Dan The Automator."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Gorillaz Debut Album Collaboration
xref.body: Del the Funky Homosapien contributed as a rapper to the Gorillaz's debut album and was featured on the single "Clint Eastwood." In Gorillaz lore, he is identified as "Del the ghost rapper," one of the spirits inhabiting Russell Hobbs, and is visually depicted as a blue phantom in the music video. "Damon, being responsible for the music, brought in rapper Del the funky homo sapien, turned table as Kid Koala, an American hip-hop producer, Dan the Automator."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Solo Album with Trent Reznor - Unreleased
xref.body: After Rage Against the Machine disbanded in 2000, Zack De La Rocha began working on a solo record, delving into hip hop and freestyle rapping. He collaborated with DJ Shadow, Dan the Automator, and Trent Reznor, who produced the material. Despite the material being considered "good" by Reznor, the album was never released and was shelved indefinitely for unknown reasons. "Rage was done by 2000... But Zach was determined to go solo. He got deep into hip hop and freestyle rapping and started working with DJ Shadow, Dan the Automator, and Trent Rosner on a solo record. The material was good too, according to Trent anyway. But for a recent still unknown, the album was never released, shelved forever."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
